dct_description_sm:
Polygon data represnting Lake St Clair, Detroit River, Lake Erie Flood Prone Areas for the County of Essex. Subdivided by TYPE between Great Lakes Floodprone areas and Inland Flood Prone Area. Appropriate scale range for viewing this dataset is 1:50,000 to 1:200,000.

Contains flood extent data provided by the Essex Region Conservation Authority (ERCA) and the Lower Thames Conservation Authority (LTVCA) for the purpose of inclusion into the County of Essex Official Plan (2014). Please contact the Conservation Authority for the most up to date information.
